name: qBittorrent
summary: Download files over BitTorrent, into a folder your media server reads.
after_install: Set a password: the spanner icon, Web UI, tick Change current password. Until you do, qBittorrent invents a new one every time it starts — find the current one with `homebasectl apps logs qbittorrent`. The version here is pinned deliberately: 5.1 and later answer a login with an empty 204 rather than "Ok.", which Sonarr and Radarr read as a wrong password.

storage.description: qBittorrent's own settings, and the torrents it is working on.
Where finished downloads are put. Choose the same disk your media server reads, so a finished file is renamed into place rather than copied.
